# The extension points of Quark v1 and their shape — the record ADR-0029
# (docs/adr/0029-extension-points-do-not-grow-in-v1.md) holds them to.
#
# An extension point is a type the contract page
# (website/docs/reference/extension-contract.mdx) marks "yes": a third party
# implements it and hands it to Quark. Within v1 none of them gains a method
# or a field, and none of their members changes; TestExtensionPointsFrozen
# (internal/extbench/frozen_points_test.go) fails when the compiled API and
# this record disagree.
#
# One line per member, "<type>[.<method>]<TAB><signature>", with the
# signature rendered as acceptance/apisurface.json records it. A line without
# a method is the whole type: a function type, the record of functions
# (quarkdriver.Classifier), or an alias of an internal interface.
#
# How this file changes within v1:
#   - A NEW extension point (a new optional interface, the way the ADR adds
#     capability) adds its lines; the test's failure prints them.
#   - A line already here does not change and is not removed, and no line is
#     added to a type already here. There is no generator: an edit to an
#     existing type is an edit by hand against an accepted ADR.
# v2 re-cuts the file for the v2 contract.

quark.AfterCreateHook.AfterCreate	func(context.Context) error
quark.AfterDeleteHook.AfterDelete	func(context.Context) error
quark.AfterFindHook.AfterFind	func(context.Context) error
quark.AfterUpdateHook.AfterUpdate	func(context.Context) error
quark.BeforeCreateHook.BeforeCreate	func(context.Context) error
quark.BeforeDeleteHook.BeforeDelete	func(context.Context) error
quark.BeforeFindHook.BeforeFind	func(context.Context) error
quark.BeforeUpdateHook.BeforeUpdate	func(context.Context) error
quark.CacheLocker.AcquireLock	func(context.Context, string, time.Duration) (bool, func() error, error)
quark.CacheStore.Delete	func(context.Context, string) error
quark.CacheStore.Get	func(context.Context, string) ([]byte, error)
quark.CacheStore.InvalidateTags	func(context.Context, ...string) error
quark.CacheStore.Set	func(context.Context, string, []byte, time.Duration, ...string) error
quark.ClientProvider.GetClient	func(context.Context) (*Client, error)
quark.EventBus.Publish	func(context.Context, Event) error
quark.ExecFunc	func(context.Context, Executor, string, []any) (sql.Result, error)
quark.Middleware.WrapExec	func(ExecFunc) ExecFunc
quark.Middleware.WrapQuery	func(QueryFunc) QueryFunc
quark.Middleware.WrapQueryRow	func(QueryRowFunc) QueryRowFunc
